articles.summary: Equinox Gold reports Q3 2026 production of 237,019 oz of gold reflecting the first partial contribution from Musselwhite and Camino Rojo following the completion of the business combination with Orla on July 31. The Company's expanded Canadian platform is positioned for stronger production into year-end.
articles.title: Equinox Gold Reports Q3 Production Results Following Transformational Combination with Orla; Expanded Canadian Production Platform Positioned for Strong Finish to 2026
